en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Qasim Bin Urwa, from Abu Al Abbas and someone else, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When a number gather upon killing one man, the guardians (of the deceased) decide which one of them they would like to kill, and it is not for them that they kill more than one.
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [17:33] and whoever is killed unjustly, We have indeed Given to his heir authority, so let him not be excessive with regards to the killing’.
